current_date: Last review: September 2026 (apply page link labelled 'Updated September 2026'; page last updated 15 September 2026)
current_evidence: The council's 'Apply for planning permission' page (last updated 15 Sep 2026) links 'Validation Criteria (Local List)' at this exact URL, marked 'Updated September 2026', and the PDF says 'Last review: September 2026'.

issues.detail: Grokbot took rows for Advertisement consent (27 of 34) from Form 6, the combined 'Full planning + advertisement' checklist. It did the same for Demolition in cons area (all 33) from Form 8 'Full + conservation area' and Listed building consent (33 of 35) from Form 7 'Full + LBC'. As a result, full-planning requirements such as Affordable Housing Statement, Transport Assessment (80+ units), Self/Custom Build, Water Neutrality, BNG, Fire Statement and Air Quality appear under advert, demolition and LBC consents. The local list itself excludes Air Quality for 'Householder, Advertisement, Tree and Listed Building applications'. The council publishes stand-alone checklists for these types (Form 12 advert, Form 13 LBC) that Grokbot should have used.
issues.evidence: Source files form-6_...fulladvert.pdf, form-8_...fullca.pdf, form-7_...fulllbc.pdf; local list Air Quality exclusions

issues.detail: Some requirements are listed under Householder even though their own excerpt says householder is exempt: 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' ('required for all applications with the exceptions of: Householder...'), 'Planning Statement' ('except those for trees, householders...') and 'Lighting Assessment' ('other than householder'). Energy/Sustainability is also placed under Change of use - prior approval although non-residential change of use is exempt.
issues.evidence: Local list: Sustainability and Energy Assessment; Planning Statement; Lighting Assessment

issues.detail: Full planning rows mix sources and misattribute items. Four rows come from the Form 12 advert-only checklist: Design and Access Statement, Lighting Assessment 'where illuminated advertisements are proposed', Photographs 'showing details of the advertisements' and Planning Statement. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is placed under Full planning. Landscaping and Parking come from the Form 9 outline checklist. 29 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' even though the local list is general and applies to all relevant types. Under Lawful development cert, Grokbot lists 'Archaeological Assessment' using the LBC heritage-statement trigger and a boilerplate 'Planning Statement' row.
issues.evidence: Sources form-12_planningapplicationchecklist_advert.pdf and form-9_...outlinewithsomereservedmatters.pdf for Full planning rows

issues.detail: Local requirements in the current list that Grokbot did not capture: Road Safety Audit and Designers Response (Stage 1 RSA for residential schemes of 20+ units, certain commercial or highway works, and any new access to the Strategic Road Network); Mineral Infrastructure Statement (within 250 m of minerals infrastructure); Waste Infrastructure Statement (within a Waste Consultation Area); Historic Environment Record search (10+ residential units and other thresholds); and the Heritage Statement triggers for demolition in conservation areas and for sites in or next to scheduled monuments, registered parks/gardens or Archaeological Notification Areas (Grokbot only applies it to LBC).
issues.evidence: 'A Stage 1 RSA (preliminary design) is required for all residential developments of 20 units or greater'; 'Required for all development that falls within 250 metres of minerals infrastructure'

issues.detail: Householder misses locally triggered items: Heritage Statement (affecting the setting of a listed building), and the Planning Obligation Instruction Form for annexes within the 7 km Ashdown Forest buffer (SAMM/SANG). The Ashdown Forest requirement appears only as tab_items text and has no app-type row with its trigger for any type, including holiday lets within 7 km.
issues.evidence: 'Applications for the creation of additional residential units or annexes within the 7km buffer'; 'Applications affecting the setting of a Listed Building'

issues.detail: Works to trees, Discharge of conditions, Non-material amendment, Permission in principle and S106 modification are all '(none)', but the council publishes dedicated checklists for each (Form 18 tree works TPO/CA, Form 40 conditions, Form 38 NMA, Form 19 PiP, Form 14 modification/discharge of obligation), and none were read. The Tree Report trigger (trees within 15 m or trees to be removed) also applies to tree applications.
issues.evidence: Apply for planning permission page, 'Checklist for Form 14/18/19/38/40' links

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are garbled or cut off. 'Habitats Regulations Assessment / SPA mitigation' shows the 2021 Fire Statement legislative note and has an empty source, not the Ashdown Forest 7 km trigger. Householder 'Flood Risk Assessment' reads only 'Act 2006 Flood Risk Assessment'. Full 'Transport Assessment' shows Travel Plan text instead of the thresholds (TA >80 dwellings or >2,500 sqm E(g); TS 50-80 dwellings or 1,500-2,500 sqm). 'Air Quality' omits the major-development and B8 500 sqm+ triggers. 'Viability' ('met then a Viability Appraisal will be required...'), 'CIL' ('of the Community Infrastructure Levy Regulations 2010.') and 'Drainage Strategy' ('treatments) and SUDS features will be required.') are fragments.
issues.evidence: Local list Transport Assessment: 'Residential development of more than 80 units'; Air Quality: 'B8 storage and distribution use class with a floorspace of 500m2 or more'

issues.detail: tab_items include process text and web-page link lists rather than requirements: 'Apply online with Planning Portal MSDC e-forms...Paper applications...'; 'Checklist for Form 40 Guidance Legal instruction form (Ashdown Forest) Application form: 41.'; a run of link titles ('Biodiversity Net Gain Statement Self-build and Custom Build Statement Additional documentation...'); 'Infrastructure (December 2025) Please see the Ashdown Forest page...'; and a combined Planning Obligation form / 2021 Fire Statement note.

'Water Neutrality Statement' is listed for Full, Outline, advert, demolition and LBC from the Form 5/6/7/8 checklists, but the September 2026 local list does not mention water neutrality or the Sussex North Water Resource Zone. The checklists may predate the list, so the requirement's current status should be confirmed. The excerpt also only says part of Bolney/Twineham is in the zone, not what has to be submitted.
issues.evidence: Local list text has no reference to water neutrality; Form 8 checklist footer dated 'September 2024'

issues.detail: The Ashdown Forest 7 km annex/units item appears twice in tab_items (from the local list and from Form 5). docs_read lists two different Form 10 URLs (jyeel2ta and kz2htq5i), and only jyeel2ta is linked from the current page. LBC has both 'Heritage Statement' and 'Archaeological Assessment' rows for the same Heritage Statement requirement.

summary: The link is the current Validation Criteria (Local List), last reviewed September 2026. Grokbot's app-type mapping is unreliable: combined 'Full +' checklists were used for advert, demolition and LBC; householder-exempt items appear under Householder; and several types are '(none)' despite council checklists. Road Safety Audit and the mineral/waste infrastructure statements are missing.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
